answer: Hardware-backed remote attestation deters Sybil attacks by requiring each agent, whether routing island microgrid power at dawn or verifying jade provenance, to bind its identity key inside a Trusted Platform Module that signs challenge nonces under a vendor certificate. Because non-exportable keys resist cloning, an adversary incurs the verifiable cost of physical silicon per alias. However, this concentrates trust in chip vendors whose compromised signing roots could mint fake attestations.
